messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 30(11)

Article 30 Requirements relating to notified bodies. 11. A conformity assessment body shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities and the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 and shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group.

response.text:
conformity assessment body | shall participate in or ensure informing of | relevant standardisation activities | instead of participating itself, its personnel responsible for conformity assessment tasks are informed | "shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, the relevant standardisation activities"
conformity assessment body | shall participate in or ensure informing of | activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42 | instead of participating itself, its personnel responsible for conformity assessment tasks are informed | "shall participate in, or ensure that its personnel responsible for carrying out the conformity assessment tasks are informed of, ... the activities of the notified body coordination group established under Article 42"
conformity assessment body | shall apply as general guidance | administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of the notified body coordination group | "" | "shall apply as general guidance the administrative decisions and documents produced as a result of the work of that group"
